headline: PM Tarique pays tribute to parents on National Revolution and Solidarity Day
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia at Zia Uddyan to mark the occasion.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman paid tribute to former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia on National Revolution and Solidarity Day.
The Prime Minister visited the graves at Zia Uddyan in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka, on Saturday morning, where he offered floral wreaths and prayed for their souls.
He was accompanied by BNP central leaders and activists from various wings and affiliate organizations of the party.

Following the tribute, BNP Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that the nation gained true independence on November 7, citing the establishment of multi-party democracy under Ziaur Rahman's leadership.
Rizvi claimed that the spirit of November 7 influenced the 2024 uprising and warned that the people would resist any attempt to bring back 'fascists'.
He also alleged that miscreants, funded by conspirators hiding in neighboring countries, are carrying out cocktail bomb explosions in various parts of the country.
caption:
PM Tarique Rahman pays tribute to Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia to mark National Revolution and Solidarity Day.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman paid tribute to former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia on National Revolution and Solidarity Day.

The Prime Minister visited the graves at Zia Uddyan in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka, on Saturday morning, where he offered floral wreaths and prayed for their souls.

He was accompanied by BNP central leaders and activists from various wings and affiliate organizations of the party.

Following the tribute, BNP Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that the nation gained true independence on November 7, citing the establishment of multi-party democracy under Ziaur Rahman's leadership.

Rizvi claimed that the spirit of November 7 influenced the 2024 uprising and warned that the people would resist any attempt to bring back 'fascists'.

He also alleged that miscreants, funded by conspirators hiding in neighboring countries, are carrying out cocktail bomb explosions in various parts of the country.

headline: 229 wickets in 64 Tests: Mohammed Shami retires from Test cricket
summary: The 36-year-old Indian pacer announced his retirement on the anniversary of his debut, ending a 13-year journey in the longest format.
details: Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from Test cricket, ending a career as one of India's most dependable fast bowlers. He shared the news via Instagram on the anniversary of his Test debut.
caption:
229 wickets and a legacy of seam movement. Mohammed Shami has called it a day in Test cricket.

Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from Test cricket, ending a career as one of India's most dependable fast bowlers. He shared the news via Instagram on the anniversary of his Test debut.
